entries.label: TRID_DAN_TR_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 原來要變成小星星的是我嗎！？

entries.label: TRID_GYM_MUSHI_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 迷你芙這道牆！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳三兩下就越過去了呢。

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: 有沒有道館測驗的\n挑戰者啊！？　▶

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是道館測驗的挑戰者吧！？\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的提示我要了！

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 輸了的話，就要說出\n自己的提示對吧。

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
我得到的提示是
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]藍色的鳥寶可夢的聲音[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！\c
我好在意這謎語一般的內容，
根本沒辦法專心對戰……

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: 我一定要點到秘密菜單！　▶

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳知道秘密菜單的提示嗎？\c\n那我就把[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳打敗，然後問出提示吧！

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 互相爭奪提示的道館測驗……\n……怎麼這麼殘忍啊！

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
我收到的提示是
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]被樓梯包圍的黑暗[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！\c
我不記得在這樣的城鎮裡
有什麼黑暗的地方啊？

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_03_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳正在接受道館測驗對不對！？\n告訴我秘密菜單的提示。\r\n告訴我！告訴我！告訴我～！

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_03_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 如果提示和寶可夢一樣，\n能交換的話不是很好嗎？

entries.label: TRID_GYM_NORMAL_03_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
我的提示是
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]冰淇淋攤位的不速之客[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]。\c
……輸掉對戰好不甘心，
我要去大吃特吃冰淇淋！

entries.label: TRID_GYM_DENKI_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 不管是贏了還是輸了\n都想炒熱氣氛！

entries.label: TRID_GYM_DENKI_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我對奇樹大人的心意\n可沒有輸給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳喔。

entries.label: TRID_GYM_ESPER_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 不論是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳還是寶可夢\n都有完美的BODY。

entries.label: TRID_GYM_ESPER_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 實在是比不上年輕人的成長呢。

entries.label: TRID_GYM_MUSHI_LEADER_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我的寶可夢們\n通～通都已經氣若游絲了～

entries.label: TRID_GYM_MIZU_LEADER_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 呃啊！呃啊～！\n是個活力充沛過頭的訓練家呀！

entries.label: TRID_GYM_ESPER_LEADER_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳那強大的力量\n是解不開的魔法。

entries.label: TRID_GYM_GHOST_LEADER_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: Punchline的水準天差地遠！\n就算輸了我還是興致不減！

entries.label: TRID_E4_HAGANE_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 打起精神來，沒什麼大不了。

entries.label: TRID_E4_HIKOU_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 空中的鳥寶可夢都會被\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的氣勢嚇到摔下來。

entries.label: TRID_RIVAL_02_KUSA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的成長之快速讓我嚇了一跳呢！

entries.label: TRID_RIVAL_02_HONO_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的成長之快速讓我嚇了一跳呢！

entries.label: TRID_RIVAL_02_MIZU_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的成長之快速讓我嚇了一跳呢！

entries.label: TRID_RIVAL_04_KUSA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 啊哈哈！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳越來越成熟了！

entries.label: TRID_RIVAL_04_HONO_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 啊哈哈！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳越來越成熟了！

entries.label: TRID_RIVAL_04_MIZU_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 啊哈哈！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳越來越成熟了！

entries.label: TRID_RIVAL_05_KUSA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 今後大家會更加注意[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳這號人物吧。

entries.label: TRID_RIVAL_05_HONO_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 今後大家會更加注意[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳這號人物吧。

entries.label: TRID_RIVAL_05_MIZU_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 今後大家會更加注意[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳這號人物吧。

entries.label: TRID_DAN_DOKU_BOSS_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 這就叫做地利不如人和啊。

entries.label: TRID_DAN_FAIRY_BOSS_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 可惡啊～！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳強得太犯規啦！

entries.label: TRID_DAN_KAKUTOU_BOSS_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 雖然很不甘心，但[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳真的很強呢！

entries.label: TRID_GYM_ESPER_LEADER_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 真是讓人驚訝的前後轉變呢。

entries.label: TRID_GYM_KOORI_LEADER_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我並不討厭[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的熱情喔。

entries.label: TRID_GYM_MIZU_LEADER_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我的心境如同一片明鏡止水！

entries.label: TRID_PEPPER_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳又強又帥氣耶～\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳真是我引以為傲的好朋友！

entries.label: TRID_KIHADA_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我感受到[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳那精鍊過的意志了！

entries.label: TRID_CHAIRPERSON_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 帕底亞的未來可真是一片光明。

entries.label: TRID_PEPPER_03_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 獒教父已經很努力了！\n……我下次是不會輸的！

entries.label: TRID_BOTAN_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 人家的布布們都不布了……

entries.label: TRID_KIHADA_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 流過的淚水和汗水\n會讓人和寶可夢更加強大！

entries.label: TRID_TAIMU_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 哎呀哎呀，計算都被打亂了。

entries.label: TRID_REHORU_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 就把這場敗仗……\n刻進歷史當中吧。

entries.label: TRID_MIMOZA_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 真是的～！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳應該要放點水的啊！

entries.label: TRID_SAWARO_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 變強的秘訣在於均衡的飲食。是吧？

entries.label: TRID_ZINIA_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳知道很多寶可夢的知識呢。

entries.label: TRID_RIVAL_08_KUSA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 雖然覺得不甘心，但真是愉快！\n下次再一起對戰吧！

entries.label: TRID_RIVAL_08_HONO_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 雖然覺得不甘心，但真是愉快！\n下次再一起對戰吧！

entries.label: TRID_RIVAL_08_MIZU_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 雖然覺得不甘心，但真是愉快！\n下次再一起對戰吧！

entries.label: TRID_CLAVEL_02_KUSA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 學生們的成長才是我的寶物喔。

entries.label: TRID_CLAVEL_02_HONO_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 學生們的成長才是我的寶物喔。

entries.label: TRID_CLAVEL_02_MIZU_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 學生們的成長才是我的寶物喔。

entries.label: TRID_E4_DRAGON_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 這場對戰讓小生覺得\n當上老師真是太好了！

entries.label: TRID_CHAIRPERSON_03_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳才是照亮眾人的帕底亞之光。

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我們寶可夢訓練家呢，\n只要向對方搭話了就要對戰！

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 帕底亞的寶可夢訓練家要對戰時，\n會發出聲音向對方搭話。\r\n光對上視線的話，對方是不會知道的。

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳贏過我的話，\n我就告訴[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一件好事情！

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我輸了！\n明明寶可夢的體力是全滿的！

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 寶可夢中心會免費為\n寶可夢進行回復喔！\r\n……咦！[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳早就知道啦！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: 買好東西後就萬無一失了。　▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳來得正是時候！\n要來一場寶可夢對戰對吧？

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 嗚哇～\n發起對戰後卻被打敗了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 用在友好商店買的傷藥來回復吧……

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳看看我剛才捕捉到的\n帥氣寶可夢吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 光只有帥氣是不行的嗎？

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我的咬咬龜是在水池的附近捕捉到的。\n水屬性是不是喜歡有水的地方啊？

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我要打倒[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳，讓寶可夢變強！

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 多多對戰的話，\n寶可夢就會提升等級，並且變強喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我啊，可是擁有２隻寶可夢。\n很厲害的喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 對戰的時候，同行隊伍中最上面的\n寶可夢會被派出來！\r\n這是寶可夢訓練家該有的基本常識喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 要不要在上學途中和叔叔\n來一場寶可夢對戰啊！

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 要前往學校所在的桌台市，\n就沿著道路一直走！\r\n小心不要迷路啦！

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 說到爬山！\n一要腰腿！\r\n二要腰腿！！

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 沒有三和四！\n腰腿腰腿！唯一腰腿！

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 說到爬山，就少不了坡道！\c\n如果是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的話，那種程度的坡道\n靠氣勢就能爬上去囉！

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: 既然[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是訓練家，\n就應該答得出來才對！　▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 考考[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳！\n寶可夢的體力耗盡時，\r\n會發生什麼事呢？

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 答案是……如[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳所見！\n再也沒有精神戰鬥了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
體力變為零……
也就是陷入瀕死的寶可夢
是沒辦法用傷藥治癒的。
得把牠帶去寶可夢中心才行。

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 這裡就是桌台市……\n雖然我正在送貨的路上，\r\n還是跟[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳來場對戰吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 桌台市面積廣大，\n不看地圖App可是會迷路的。

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 奇怪的蓋子讓我在意得不得了！\n用寶可夢對戰來轉移注意力吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 那個蓋子到底是……\n啊！我已經輸了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
前面的懸崖處有個
被鎖鍊繫著的蓋子！\c
而且淡淡地發著光。
那到底是什麼東西……？

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 本地最強的男子漢在此！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳贏得了本大爺嗎！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 從今天起，本大爺是第二強的男子漢！

entries.label: TRID_AREA01_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 南第１區以外的地方\n存在著更強的傢伙嗎……？

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 作為寶可夢聯盟巡禮的紀念，\n我們來對戰吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 輸掉對戰也是一種紀念！

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 雖然我連１個道館徽章也沒有，\n要不要還是去試試看面試測驗呢～

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我想為有前途的年輕人帶來經驗。

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 哈，哈，哈！我有沒有帶給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳經驗啊？

entries.label: TRID_AREA03_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳如果靠著和叔叔我的對戰經驗\n變得更強，而成為了冠軍，\r\n那叔叔我也會是冠軍的一部分對吧？

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 竟然忘記買食材了。\n哼！我要用寶可夢對戰來發洩！

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我本來是打算在野餐中做三明治，\n和寶可夢一起吃的。

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 肚子餓了的話就吃三明治！！\c\n建議[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳事先買好充足的食材，\n這樣就隨時都能製作了！！

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我要讓自己的蟲寶可夢累積經驗！

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 牠有進化的話我就贏了說！

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 聽說蟲寶可夢比一般的\n寶可夢來得早進化。\c\n我的圓法師是不是也快要進化了呢？

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 要不要我告訴[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳\n前往帕底亞十景的方法！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
帕底亞十景之一的
橄欖大農園
就在那邊的寶可夢中心對面！
順著路走很快就到了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 寶可夢的掉落物收集到了，\n接下來就收集獎金吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我會給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳獎金，\n但掉落物可不會給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳……！

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我正在收集寶可夢的掉落物\n來製作招式學習器。

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 別看俺人生已經６０載！\n老頭兒也能挑戰道館！

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 還沒到達道館就先輸了的\n老頭兒就在此……

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 「要是迷路了，就按Ｙ鍵看地圖App！」\c\n女兒老是跟俺這麼嘮叨，\n她到底是在說啥啊……

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我可以捕捉[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳培育的寶可夢嗎～！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 別人的寶可夢不可以捕捉啊……

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 拿走別人的東西就是小偷！\n所以我還是只捕捉野生的寶可夢吧……

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我該走的路途究竟在何方？\n我一直漫無目的地打轉著。

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 難道這場敗北也是\n我該走的路嗎……！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 要是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳和我一樣\n迷失了該走的路途，\r\n就去寶可夢中心問路吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是跟我同一所學校的吧？\n我們來交流一下資訊吧！\r\n不過當然要等到對戰之後！

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 就算上的課程一樣，\n得到的資訊量也不同……！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 河川再過去的地方是南第４區！\n那裡有著比這裡更強的寶可夢喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳有太晶珠對吧！？\n好厲～害！讓我看，讓我看～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 有的寶可夢在太晶化之後，\n不是會變成不同屬性嗎？\c\n好想要會變成火屬性的粉蝶蟲喔～

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 寶可夢大問答，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳答對了嗎？

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 剛才的對戰應該讓圓陸鯊\n登錄到[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的寶可夢圖鑑了！\r\n看看牠在哪裡棲息，去捕捉牠吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 買到派舒蕾・慕滋的蛋糕心情大好，\n所以我們來對戰一場吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 有了這美味的蛋糕，\n就算輸了也心情大好！

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 派舒蕾・慕滋的店長阿楓\n是最優秀的甜點師！\r\n她同時也是道館館主喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 這位客人！\n來一場刺激的對戰如何呀？

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 在和我對戰之後\n購買解麻藥的客人\r\n好像滿多的。哦呵呵……

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是學院的學生嗎？\n知不知道「天星隊」這號集團？

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我滿腦子都想著天星隊，\n不知不覺中就輸了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 聽說天星隊建立起基地，\n佔據了一些區域呢。

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 做學姐的我來幫忙看看\n學[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]弟妹[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的寶可夢吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 做學姐的我能教[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的，\n就是走路時把寶可夢中心當作標的，\r\n便不容易迷路～

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳去過深缽道館了沒？\n我已經去過了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 深缽道館的悲劇，再次上演！

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我可是被道館館主寇沙\n打得慘兮兮喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 欸欸，聽我說喔！\n一閃一閃，晶亮晶亮的！

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 正當我接近一閃一閃發著光的寶可夢，\n準備要捕捉牠的時候……\c\n牠就突然晶亮晶亮起來，太晶化了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 登、登、登登登♪\n這是寶可夢中心的回復音效！

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 登、登、登登登……\n又得去回復體力了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 既然要去寶可夢中心，\n就順便買些傷藥吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 先由我展示我的寶可夢！

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 欣賞到了很厲害的寶可夢。

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 在對戰中看到的寶可夢\n會被登錄進圖鑑App！\r\n所以我才會用對戰來互相展示。

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 從樹叢當中……哇！！\n怎麼樣！嚇到了嗎？

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 嚇到我了，嚇死人了！\n我輸了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 從寶可夢的背後靠近牠，\n嚇牠一跳的話，\r\n說不定會有好事喔……？

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 喂……岩壁……也太扯……！\n寶可夢……超扯……對吧！！

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 敗給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳之後，我冷靜下來了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我靠上岩壁後，岩壁突然動起來，\n沿著崖面爬了上去！\r\n那其實不是岩壁，而是寶可夢嗎……？

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳正在尋寶啊？\n我以前也尋寶過喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 尋寶是學院的一項傳統。

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 遲遲沒有作曲的靈感，\n所以我需要刺激！

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 託[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的福，\n我感覺能寫出好曲子囉。

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 問[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳喔！[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳在學校裡\n最喜歡的老師是誰～？

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我最喜歡的是吉尼亞老師！

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳就在吉尼亞老師的\n班上啊！？真好～

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我正在猶豫要在尋寶當中做的事。\n總之，做什麼好呢？

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 讓寶可夢攜帶厲害道具的我超厲害。\n來和我一戰吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 是個不把厲害的我和厲害道具\n當回事的厲害訓練家！

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
我讓寶可夢攜帶吃剩的東西，
牠已經在緩緩地回復體力了！\c
像我這種難纏的訓練家啊，
都會用一聽就覺得很厲害的語氣說話喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我正在外勤！也就是在外面奔波！

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 在工作中去公司以外的地方\n會讓我有些興奮。

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 繪畫的模特兒啊……\n就是即將平伏在我腳下的[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 繪畫的道路跟對戰的道路\n都好難走啊～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 又得去找繪畫的模特兒了。\n最好是比我弱的人。

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我要帶著多種屬性的寶可夢\n跟[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳來一場均衡的對戰！

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 帶著多種不同屬性的寶可夢的話，\n不管是什麼樣的狀況應該都能應付。

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我也正在尋寶。\n我是不會輸給年輕人的。

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的話，一定能找到寶物的。

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 不管到了多少歲，\n經驗都是寶物呢。

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 哇～[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳真的來了！\n那我們就對戰一場吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 遇到有人說著自己在意的事，\n就會忍不住跑去搭話呢。

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 這裡是我的秘密基地！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要是輸了就出去！

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 咦咦～！？\n結果要出去的是我嗎～！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 要到達這裡很辛苦對吧。\n現在這是我們倆的秘密基地了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 南第４區非常廣大，\n所以三不五時就要為寶可夢洗澡澡！\r\n這樣寶可夢才會常保活力喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 時代劇裡經常說「請指教」，\n不是為了請對方對戰，\r\n而是要請對方指點自己。

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 靠著珍藏的樹果，\n我成功地消除了弱點！

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 明明沒有弱點，我還是輸了嗎！

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 讓寶可夢攜帶某種樹果後，\n就算受到效果絕佳的招式攻擊，\r\n傷害也會減少，讓人很放心。

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 贏過本大爺的話，\n我就告訴[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳寶物在哪裡！

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 寶物就是我們的相遇……才怪！

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 那座塔上有寶箱喔！\c\n但我都還沒有碰，它就動了起來，\n嚇得我不敢打開……

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 填滿寶可夢圖鑑是我的樂趣！[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳呢？

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 透過圖鑑查看棲息地，\n就能知道寶可夢的出沒時間和地點。

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我好想看[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳帶著的\n可愛寶可夢喔～

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 寶可夢有好多不同的種類，\n牠們都可愛得不得了～

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 走到死路時只有回頭一途。\n真是惱人……對吧？

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 早知道就老老實實地回頭了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 要是坐騎寶可夢能\n攀爬懸崖，\r\n搞不好就到得了南第６區呢……

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 不好意思打著赤腳。\n還請多多指教。

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 如果我有穿鞋子，搞不好就贏了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 其他空手道王打著赤腳，\n踩到石頭都不會痛嗎……？

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: 這一帶的寶可夢……\n太強了吧？　▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 不覺得這一帶的寶可夢很強嗎？\n最好還是回頭對不對？

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我如果像[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一樣強，\n大概就不會有問題了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 打倒強力的寶可夢時，\n增進的實力會相對應地提升。\r\n但若打不贏就沒有意義了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我在學院已經就讀了２０年！

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我的學分不夠，所以已經念了２０年！\n是不是差不多該畢業啦？

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 睡褲棉褲休閒褲，\n短褲小子我最酷！

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 來一場寶可夢對戰。您意下如何？\n讓我們共度愉快的時光吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 強力的招式，帥氣的招式……\n招式有著各式各樣的種類，\r\n而我喜歡的是愉快的招式。

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 玻瓶道館的道館館主\n海岱先生很厲害喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 沒能讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳知道我有多厲害！

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 海岱先生是\n水屬性寶可夢的行家！\r\n小心他那流水般的戰術啊。

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 為什麼不可以去帕底亞巨坑啊？

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 一個會輸給小孩子的人\n去那種地方確實有危險……

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 據說帕底亞巨坑的深處\n存在著最強的守護者喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我正在用發不出聲音的吉他\n鍛鍊手臂和頸部！

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 青春是什麼？\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳回答得出來嗎？

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 或許要在長大之後回顧，\n才會明白什麼是青春吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 有奇怪的寶可夢！\n有奇怪的寶可夢！

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 有奇怪的寶可夢！\n稍後我就跟[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳說！

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我在沙漠中遇見了奇怪的寶可夢。\c\n牠長得和頓甲這種寶可夢一模一樣，\n但又好像不是頓甲……？

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 沙子跑進鞋子裡會怎麼樣呢？

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 答案是一直在意著沙子，\n而輸了對戰～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 鞋子裡的沙子！\n如果就這麼一直留在裡面，\r\n久了也就習慣了呢。

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 呀呀！呼呼！？\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是怎麼到這種地方的！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是騎著坐騎寶可夢上來的吧。\n……摩托蜥辦得到這種事來著？

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我是工人！\n大小施工通通包辦！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 因為有工人在，所以不論是學校\n還是寶可夢聯盟都蓋得起來。

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 教教我嘛～！\n教教我敗北的滋味～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 敗北可真不是蓋的。\n謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳教會我。

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 好好好，我這就讓寶可夢漂漂亮亮。

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 寶可夢還是戰鬥時的模樣最漂亮。

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 忘記寫功課了！\n我贏的話就讓我抄[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳選的是什麼課？\n我是對戰學和生物課！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我聽說成為登山女孩的話，\n就會很受歡迎。

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 要受歡迎的難度比山還高！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 登山女孩很受寶可夢的歡迎！\n這樣其實也不錯！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 發現名為強敵的高山了！\n讓我攀登上去吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我同班同學的[VAR 0x1107(00FF,0202)]媽媽爸爸！\n可是很有名的博士喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我自己沒什麼了不起的！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 有個有名的[VAR 0x1107(00FF,0202)]媽媽爸爸好酷喔～

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 有個很強的女孩來跟我對戰，\n結果我三兩下就輸了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 那個很強的女孩……\n她的實力無庸置疑，\r\n想必是冠軍級的。

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 要不要看我超酷的寶可夢模型？

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 嘎啊～\n噗呃呃呃呃！我輸了～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的寶可夢超帥氣！\n製作成模型的話我就買！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 寶可夢有多強和幾歲根本無關！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 就算是小孩子也贏得了大人，\n所以寶可夢對戰才有趣。

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是從小匙鎮來的？\n我是冰櫃鎮來的！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我背負著冰櫃鎮的名聲，\n但卻輸給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳了……

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 冰櫃鎮有超美麗的雪景！\n而且還有漂亮的演唱會會場，\r\n所以不輸給小匙鎮喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 在教室裡念書\n和在外面冒險，\r\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳喜歡哪一種？

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳喜歡寶可夢這一點我明白了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 要讓我來選的話，\n我比較喜歡在教室裡念書！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 光靠吆喝是贏不了的嗎？

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 唔～！哈～！\n我模仿自己景仰的格鬥家吆喝，\r\n但還是沒能獲勝。

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我最喜歡像怪獸的寶可夢～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 雖然怪獸在電影裡總是被打敗，\n不過在現實中真希望牠能贏呢！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳剛才亂丟東西對不對！？\n為了守護海灘，我不惜一戰！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 不好意思啊，是我看錯了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
這裡是帕底亞十景的
其中之一，僻靜海灘……\c
自從成為觀光景點後，人就多了起來，
使得僻靜海灘都不僻靜了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 為了讓我保持體態，請[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳跟我作伴！

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 出了不少汗，應該瘦了一些吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 寶可夢對戰讓訓練家也能運動到，\n真是一舉兩得～

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 輸了對戰，整個人更不安了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 前往焙固鎮的方法\n似乎就是沿著路一直走……\r\n不過……這真的是路嗎……？

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我要以這片美景為背景，\n自拍下戰勝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的英姿！

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 結果拍出的是漏氣的模樣！

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我原本打算拿自拍的照片\n當作個人資訊裡的頭像。

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我在焙固鎮的道館吞了敗仗，\n目前正在鍛鍊中。

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
焙固道館的道館館主莉普
是超能力屬性的行家。\c
我的格鬥寶可夢拿牠們
一點辦法都沒有……

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 用我在學校前的地獄樓梯\n鍛鍊過的雙腳，一、二、一、二！

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 要是鍛鍊雙腳後\n寶可夢也會變強就好了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
學校前的地獄樓梯
真是長得要命！\c
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳偶爾會看到學生會長
坐在樓梯上休息喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 看到小孩一個人的，真叫人擔心啊！\n叔叔陪[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一起走吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 既然[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳有那樣的實力，\n就不需要擔心了……

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 要小心危險的人跟寶可夢喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 這裡對登山女孩而言\n就如同樂園一樣！！

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我的心情都要飛上天了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 平坦的路途枯燥乏味！\n人生就是要有起有伏嘛！

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 讓我一窺[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的未來，\n看[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳能否穿過這個洞窟。

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的話，就能夠無所不達……

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 在這個洞窟裡不斷往上爬，\n就會到達焙固鎮……\c\n途中請以火炬為路標前進。

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我原本在追寶可夢，\n追著追著就完全迷路了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我連追逐勝利也追到迷路。

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 要是真的迷路了，\n我會呼叫飛翔計程車的。

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我下定決心不靠坐騎寶可夢，\n步行到達城鎮。

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我的雙腿在咯咯笑著，\n心裡卻好想哭。

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 好，稍微休息一下！\n餵寶可夢一些三明治吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 尋寶好快樂～！\n贏過[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳就更快樂了～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 輸給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳就變得好傷心～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 不覺得尋寶這項校外研究\n實在是太快樂了嗎？\c\n這是重新審視自己的好機會呢！

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 寶可夢的屬性也太複雜了吧？

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 水剋火這一點我能明白，\n但惡為什麼能剋超能力？

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 呼啊，呼啊！\n要前往城鎮好辛苦啊！

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 如果我沒有累成這個樣子，\n大概就贏了吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 送快遞去焙固鎮\n應該要多收費用的！

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 有坐騎寶可夢能在\n這麼陡的斜坡上移動嗎……？

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 真是奇特的寶可夢……\n我從來沒有見過。

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 就用我勤奮鍛鍊出的自豪肌肉\n跟[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一決勝負吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 原來這不是肌肉，根本是雞肋！

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我可不是在寶可夢道館\n勤奮鍛鍊……\r\n而是運動中心！！

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 讓我告訴[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳\n我在意天氣的理由吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 沙暴是一種天氣！\n……是天氣喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
沙暴真正可怕的地方
不是它的傷害……\c
而是岩石屬性的特防
會比平時更強韌！

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 作為到達焙固鎮的紀念，\n請[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳跟我對戰～

entries.label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 出焙固空洞後才會到焙固鎮……？\n還要再更上面！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 請問一下～[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳知道天星隊毒幫班的\n基地在哪裡嗎？

entries.label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 地圖看錯，戰局也誤判了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 天星隊毒幫班的基地\n好像在河川對岸。

entries.label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 偶爾回學校上課，\n會對自己有幫助的。

entries.label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳知道樹為什麼會五彩繽紛嗎！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 為樹木上顏色的\n是一種叫做塗標客的寶可夢。\r\n牠跟我一樣有品味呢。

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 呵！呵！呵！\n我就把對戰的機會賣給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
在商店裡能夠將道具以
原價４分之１的價格賣出！\c
金珠這類東西的主要用途
就是賣掉換成金錢。

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 讓我教教[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳鋼屬性有多堅韌！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳早就知道鋼屬性的弱點了嗎？

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
鋼屬性不但弱點少，
而且不會陷入中毒狀態！\c
但要是被火屬性熔化
或被格鬥屬性應聲撂倒，
會有點難過就是了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 東第３區是礦山地帶！\n我要大挖特挖金屬囉！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 這個時間點正好。\n我看就回去穴扎鎮\r\n稍微休息一下吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 既然叫做礦山……\n是不是代表可以爬上去？

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 就算問[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳也不知道啊。

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 礦山裡有個山字，\n照理來說應該也可以爬吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 想成為我進化後的寶可夢的\n墊腳石嗎！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我的寶可夢才剛進化，\n所以還不知道怎麼戰鬥！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 鯉魚王進化後\n會變成暴鯉龍這點可真厲害。\r\n我也好想進化成怪獸啊。

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 這附近到處都是沙子，\n我的嘴巴裡也沙沙的……

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我還在弄沙子的時候，\n對戰已經結束了～

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 就算是在沙暴的天氣下，\n有防塵護目鏡就不會有事。\r\n雖然沙子大概還是會跑進嘴巴裡！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: 就是要在嚴峻的環境下！　▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 就是要在嚴峻的環境下，\n修行才會有成果！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 如果是在南國的海灘上\n愉快地修行……\r\n是否就會效果不好？

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: 我看到了好厲害的東西！　▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我看到了好厲害的東西！\n要說看到了什麼啊……

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 在這裡也看到了好厲害的寶可夢！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
我看到跟釀光市的大樓一樣大的寶可夢
從地面鑽了出來！\c
牠長得跟別的地區那大大的
地鼠像一模一樣！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳討厭悲傷的歌嗎？\n我……算是普普吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 輸了對戰好悲傷。\n嚕啦啦，嚕啦～♪

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 雖然只是個人見解，\n我認為越開朗的人越喜歡悲傷的歌！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 來吧來吧，\n來跟本大爺試試手氣！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 究竟是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的運氣好，\n還是本大爺的運氣不好……

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 揮指是完全看運氣的招式！\n所以說，我並不是在實力上輸給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳。

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳應該要多考慮到人家的可愛啊～

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 當初是不是應該多磨練\n寶可夢的可愛才對……？

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是學生嗎？\n我來瞧瞧[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的實力吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 剛才失禮了。\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳才是擁有實力的強者。

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我想跟有骨氣的傢伙對戰！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳有沒有啊？

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 真是久違的好對戰！\n謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳來向我搭話！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 在粗獷的地方就會有很多\n粗獷的寶可夢吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 輕飄飄的寶可夢是不是會\n出現在花田之類的地方？

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 前方的印記樹林裡\n有不良分子遊蕩，很危險喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 哎呀，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳很強呢。\n我是不是多管閒事了？

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 那群人叫做天星隊嗎？\n聽說他們是不良分子，很可怕。\r\n雖然我沒有受害過……

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳以為我會派出龍屬性，\n才過來搭話的對吧？

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我這身在對戰前就透露出寶可夢屬性的裝扮\n其實會讓自己吃虧嗎……？

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 孩子就快要出生了！\n所以我各方面都得好好努力！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 對戰也該多努力一點才是啊！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 孩子生下來後，\n我要讓他上跟[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一樣的學校！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 根據我的計算，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳過來搭話的機率是１００％！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳有上泰姆老師的課嗎？\n喜歡數字的人會學得很開心。

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我贏過[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的話，\n就要去向心儀的人告白！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 雖然輸了，但我也鬆了一口氣！

entries.label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 照這樣下去，最後一步我會\n一直裹足不前的。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 在寒冷的地方會稍微輕鬆一點！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 會輕鬆的只有快遞喔！\n對戰還是沒那麼簡單！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 溫度低的話，貨物就不易腐壞，\n所以不用費力趕路！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我為了前往霜抹山道館而來到這裡，\n但這裡還真冷啊～

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 帕底亞這個地區隨著位置不同，\n氣候也完全不同呢！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 這一帶的溫度很低，\n不穿冬衣可是會很難受的。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 雪山好在哪裡！\n讓我來告訴[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 冰屬性的寶可夢！\n在雪山裡有很多很多喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 聽說啊！世界著名的饒舌歌手萊姆\n要在冰櫃鎮舉辦演唱會！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 冰櫃鎮該不會是在……\n山的另外一邊吧！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我聽說這裡可以滑雪山，\n所以特地遠道而來喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我所進行的尋寶是創下\n滑雪山的最佳紀錄。哦呵呵……

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我要來見前職業滑雪選手\n古魯夏大人一面，但是卻迷路了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 不管怎麼樣，\n登上山頂是否就能看見\r\n古魯夏大人所在的霜抹山道館呢？

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳對戰好像很強呢！\n跟我打一場吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 會來到這種地方的傢伙\n肯定都很強吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我是在北方出生，\n所以天氣一寒冷就會興奮起來。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 光是把頭跟耳朵蓋住不受風吹，\n寒冷的程度就大不相同喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我說[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳啊！\n是不是在小看山！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 不可以小看登山的準備工作！\n帶著滿滿的道具再去登山喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 在校外遇到同校的人\n會有點難為情呢。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我不想在城鎮之類的地方\n遇到和自己有點關係的人。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 叔叔我有厚脂肪，\n所以一點都不怕冷！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 有厚脂肪這種特性的寶可夢\n受到火或冰屬性的招式攻擊時，\r\n受到的傷害會變少！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 刻意讓自己處在嚴苛的環境\n正是屬於我的鍛鍊方式。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
有許多龍是變溫動物，
牠們的體溫會隨氣溫變化。\c
就是因為這樣，
牠們才怕被冰降溫吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 藝術究竟是什麼……\n我完全搞不懂了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 總覺得動力湧上來了！\n謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳和我對戰啊！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 提高警覺！\n這一帶有很多強者。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 但像[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一樣強的一個也沒有。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 能來到這裡的都不會是弱者。\n我只看外表就下判斷，真是失禮了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 用雪創作的藝術品！\n為了達成這個目標，所以我就來了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 噫～輸了之後我注意到一件事！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 用雪創作的藝術品！\n一離開雪山不就要融化了？\r\n啊～不做了不做了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 看我打開相機App拍下超讚的畫面，\n在社群網路上爆紅！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 這種畫面怎麼能上傳啊～

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我貼的東西完全沒有起反應。\n是因為我沒跟任何人建立關係嗎～

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 已經滅卻心頭了，\n雪還是一樣冷得要命！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我很喜歡在山裡大喊「喲呼～」\n然後聽到「喲呼～」的回應！\r\n……那是誰在回應的啊？

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我嚮往著自由又強健的登山女孩。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 要自由和要強健都很不簡單呢～

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 山上很危險呢！\n下次改當森林女孩好了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 冰天雪地中……♪\n遇見純樸好學生……♪\r\n下一句想不出來！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我是來創作俳句的，\n但是在這裡只作得出冬天的歌。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 不管是什麼樣的對手，\n都吃我的正拳！啊喳喳喳喳～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 啊喳喳喳喳……啊啊……\n好痛，好痛啊。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我就算鍛鍊了正拳，\n在寶可夢對戰裡也沒有意義呢。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 霜抹山上的空氣清淨，\n讓我能發出美妙的聲音。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 真讓我驚訝。哇啊～！！\n……啊，發出了今天最美妙的聲音！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 要是發出太大的聲音，\n說不定會引發雪崩呢。

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳好～！我是暴牛貨運！\n我們來對戰一場吧～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 暴牛貨運的形象寶可夢\n是肯泰羅！\r\n我們和肯泰羅一樣是大力士！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我在學校看過[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳！\n是最近轉學進來的那個人對吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 轉學生，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳很強耶！\n雖然我們的年級不同，還是多指教啊。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳有沒有看過光柱？\n就算從很遠的地方也看得到喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 去調查光柱就能\n參加太晶團體戰，\r\n並且捕捉太晶寶可夢！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 在西第１區，風力發電相當興盛。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 小孩子的能量源源不絕，\n根本不用充電呢。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 水、地熱、風……\n還有從自然中產生的電力喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_KARATE_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 將武術鑽研到極致後……\n我該如何是好！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_KARATE_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 雖然我還沒鑽研到極致就是了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_KARATE_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 將武術鑽研到極致後要做什麼，\n還是等鑽研到極致後再來想吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 封印了災厄寶可夢的祠堂\n在哪裡呢～？

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我從書上知道，這一帶有\n災厄寶可夢的祠堂！\r\n……對了，「災厄」是什麼啊？

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 西第１區是風的道路！\n咻咻～咻～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 好大的風車！\n看著看著眼睛都要花了～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: Hey hey～我要搭便車～\n用坐騎寶可夢載我一程吧～

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 搭飛翔計程車往來是很輕鬆，\n但以旅行來說，未免也太沒情調了？

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我贏的話，就請[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳買我的ＣＤ！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我的ＣＤ賣不出去，\n或許是時代造成的吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 原來如此。這個地區的人果然是\n先搭話再開始對戰呢！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 先搭話再開始對戰……\n是帕底亞地區的主流文化。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 有的地區是在彼此對上視線時\n就要對戰喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 哇啊！！嚇我一跳！！\n咦！！對戰！？好啊！！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 嚇了一跳後沒掉下去\n真是太好了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
即使從高處摔下來，
也有手機洛托姆保護著。\c
萬一回不去原來的地方，
就用地圖App呼叫飛翔計程車。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 要比活力，我是不會輸的～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 要比活力，我可沒輸給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 有活力這一點是我們\n短褲愛好者共同的特色。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 前面很恐怖喔！\n寶可夢很強喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 前方的洞窟裡\n有一大堆很恐怖的寶可夢！\r\n要是覺得不妙就趕快撤退喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我是從桌台市的西門出發的！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳果然也是從西門出發啊！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 畢竟西邊有圓模道館和玻瓶道館這些\n距離很近的道館嘛！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DELIVERER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 在這一帶叫了披薩外送的是不是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳？

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DELIVERER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 早知道就應該先問清楚\n要送去哪裡了……

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是訓練家嗎？\n訓練家搭乘飛翔計程車\r\n不需支付費用。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 是位貨真價實的訓練家呢。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 訓練家搭乘飛翔計程車的費用\n會由寶可夢聯盟買單。\r\n所以請儘管搭乘，不用客氣。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 親眼一睹沙漠的模樣\n是我長年以來的夢想。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 當初有鼓起勇氣入學就讀\n真是太好了。\r\n我才得以獲得這樣的經驗。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我想到山頂去，\n但是連靠近都沒有辦法。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 騎著坐騎寶可夢衝過去的話，\n是不是就能避開岩石到達山頂了？

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TANPAN_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 對天星隊要很小心。\n他們會用獨特的方式對戰。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TANPAN_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要說獨特的話也很獨特！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TANPAN_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 聽說天星隊是讓寶可夢自主對戰的喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 和當地的人交流\n也是旅行的樂趣所在呢。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 帕底亞的孩子很厲害耶！？\n我帶來的傷藥夠不夠啊？

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我的背包裡……\n裝著寶可夢～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我的背包裡裝滿了\n珍貴的東西！\r\n如果是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳，會在背包裡裝什麼呢？

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_KARATE_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 說到空手道王……\n沒錯，就是格鬥屬性！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_KARATE_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
我們空手道王
喜歡格鬥屬性！\c
所以別在準備超能力屬性或
飛行屬性的寶可夢之後過來搭話！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我正在尋找背著硬幣的\n小小寶可夢！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 但是我怎麼找都找不到。\n……我要盯著草叢猛看。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
背著硬幣的寶可夢長得很小，
一下子就會逃走！\c
雖然沒有辦法捕捉，
不過找到牠的話，牠會掉硬幣喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 那個障礙物屬於天星隊基地的地盤，\n很危險的，所以和叔叔對戰吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 沒辦法用不著痕跡的對戰邀請\n來捉弄[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳嗎……

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 天星隊惡幫班的老大\n是個眼神凶～狠的男人喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我想得到豪華獎品！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳來跟我對戰吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
贏過訓練家很多次的話，
能得到豪華獎品。\c
這是聯盟裡的人
在寶可夢中心說的喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DELIVERER_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 反正我這個人就是不行啦！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DELIVERER_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 翹掉快遞去跟別人對戰\n果然是不行的吧……？

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我是新手上路的馴龍師！\n看我用龍之力量把[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳轟飛！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 原來弱的不是寶可夢，而是我！\n接下來我會變強的！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我的寶可夢透過招式學習器\n學會了很厲害的招式喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我得去製作更厲害的招式學習器了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 招式學習器能教會寶可夢牠平常\n無法學會的招式，相當方便。

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 大鍋湖裡真的有鍋子嗎！？\n我現在就想知道答案！

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我只知道我跟[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳打過了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 就算去了北邊的大鍋湖，\n不會游泳的話一樣沒用啊！

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳往西邊走，會看到城鎮！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳往前面看，會看到敵人！

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
往西邊走的話，
會到達市場城鎮「漬沁鎮」！\c
西邊就是地圖App上
塗了黃色的方向。

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 又厲害又罕見的寶可夢！\n很想看吧？[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳很想看對不對？

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 這個世界上好像還存在著\n顏色跟平常不一樣的寶可夢。\r\n真想一睹牠的風采。

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 在大自然的環繞和療癒之下\n來一場對戰吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我要在帕底亞所有景色優美的地方\n野餐過一遍。

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我贏的話，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳就去幫我送東西好嗎？

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 輸了之後我下定決心了！\n今天也要努力工作！

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是怎麼得到那股力量的……？

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 快來幫幫我～！我的手不聽話，\n會自己把球投出去～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我要找下一個對手了，\n趕快走開啦～真是的～

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 山！是山！\n倒過來念也一樣呢～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 倒過來念也一樣的句子\n叫做「回文」喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我是室內派的，\n但還是來這裡欣賞美景。

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
這裡叫做「列柱洞」，
是帕底亞十景之一。\c
這樣的景觀是怎麼形成的，
我要好好調查一番！

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 欸，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳知不知道……我有多厲害？

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 井底的我領略了什麼是大海！

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 世界上多得是\n比自己有才華的人呢。

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 以清爽的大海為背景，\nLet's 對戰！

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 原來這不是海……而是湖嗎！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 地圖App上顯示，\n這裡是一片湖！\c\n海跟湖的差別到底是什麼……！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 當紅的直播主奇樹！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳聽說過嗎？

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 奇樹既是直播主，\n也是道館館主！\r\n她超級可愛的，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳也去看看嘛。

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 歡迎光臨野外咖啡店。\n要來一杯敗北的滋味嗎？

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我喝一口……\n這就是敗北的滋味啊！！

entries.label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 敗北的滋味……！\n會讓人一喝再喝呢。

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 按常理來想，明明就是\n這隻寶可夢最可愛，\r\n為什麼我的朋友都不明白啊！

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 雖然輸了對戰，但咚咚鼠的可愛\n總算傳達到了，所以我很滿足。

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 咚咚鼠會偷電，所以有人喜歡牠，\n也有人很討厭牠。\r\n這明明也是牠可愛的地方啊。

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 錦匯鎮的寶食堂！\n看我在評價網站上給他們打１顆星！

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我明明就聽說在「寶食堂」這家店\n可以改變太晶屬性，\r\n頑固的廚師卻說什麼都不肯答應。

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳見識一下世紀大幻覺吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 索羅亞這種寶可夢會幻化成\n其他寶可夢，所以不容易找到。

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 雖然我有把貨物送去\n錦匯鎮對戰場的要務在身！

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我找不到路途，也抓不到勝算！

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 錦匯鎮明明就有道館，\n但是不是沒有對戰場啊？

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 好！決定了！\n我贏的話就去工作！

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 萬歲～！\n輸了對戰，所以放假一天！

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我可不是為了放假才故意輸的喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 既然同為訓練家，\n見了面就免不了一戰。

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 不論來者是誰，\n都勇於上前挑戰……\r\n我回想起了過去那樣的自己。

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 錦匯鎮的冰淇淋店裡\n有賣很奇特的東西喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 最近的冰淇淋店\n開始賣起那種\r\n又甜又鹹的甜點啦。

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 欸嘿嘿！我是咖啡店的\n招牌女店員！

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我是以可愛模樣對戰的咖啡店員！\n還請到店裡作客喔～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: 這隻寶可夢最可愛對吧？　▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 讓我來告訴[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳誰才是\n寶可夢界的可愛霸主！

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 要說布土撥的可愛之處……\n咦，我已經輸了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
布土撥的可愛之處果然還是
跟牠一起走的時候，
那副努力跟在後面的模樣吧。
而且我還聽說跟牠一起走的話，
牠就會進化喔。
哎呀～實在是太美妙了～哦呵呵。

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 要清潔的對象就是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳嗎……？

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 抱歉，是我搞錯人了。\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳什麼都別說，快走吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 上山和下山！\n要二選一的話，我喜歡下山！

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 在山裡碰到對向過來的人時，\n要由上山的人先通行喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 被搶走adventage這點是個\n相當severe的issue呢。

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳來向我搭話！\n那我們就上吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 也是呢～\n如果對自己的實力沒有把握，\r\n根本不會向人搭話嘛……

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 感覺[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳很懂得欣賞呢。\n請欣賞最可愛的寶可夢吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 冰寶被打敗的模樣\n可愛得叫人受不了呢。

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
不管怎麼想都是冰寶最可愛，
但我的朋友就是不懂。\c
在霜抹山能遇到這種寶可夢，
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳也去捉幾隻來吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 在這一帶好像有通往\n帕底亞巨坑的隧道喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 帕底亞巨坑入口的附近好像有\n無人使用的研究設施……\r\n嗯～！我好想看！好想去調查！

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我們馴龍師是\n龍屬性寶可夢的行家！！

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是實力在我之上的行家。

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 龍雖然不容易培育，\n但牠們的弱點很少……\r\n把牠們養成之後，就穩操勝算了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
……之前一直為公事頭痛得要命，
不過現在已經恢復一些精神了！\c
痛苦的時候就是要退回到
幼兒的階段啊！哇哈哈！

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 太晶珠是很貴重的東西，\n所以只有優秀的學生和老師\r\n才能擁有。沒有錯吧？

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 哇！哈！哈！\n我正在尋寶的過程中享受青春喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 懂得享樂才能當人生的贏家！\n用年紀為理由來決定做或不做\r\n就太糟蹋囉。

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我看到有輕飄飄的寶可夢\n乘著風在移動喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 哇！我以為附近都沒有人\n才敢唱歌的說！

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我會輸是因為覺得太丟臉了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我剛剛是在想\n飛翔計程車的廣告歌。\r\n飛～♪翔～♪咻咻♪

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 好難決定啊～\n要去深缽鎮感受藝術，\r\n還是去釀光市體驗都會呢？

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 要使出哪個招式，\n實在很難決定呢……

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 就去深缽鎮感受藝術吧。\n那裡的鎮上擺放著很多作品。

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 啊啊，不可以……我……\n鎮不住自己的力量！！

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 咕……謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳幫我鎮住力量……！

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我的力量偶爾會失控，\n不管看到誰都通通打倒。\r\n還好[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳沒有被這股力量吞噬……

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 考考[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳！什麼東西丟出去之後\n就會開始比勝負？

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 把裝著寶可夢的球丟向\n正在走路的寶可夢，\r\n就能直接開始對戰。很方便對吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 讓很會頑強抵抗的大叔\n展現一下頑強抵抗到底的對戰吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 一味地攻擊不叫做厲害！\n也用各種招式頑強抵抗看看喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我的寶可夢！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的寶可夢！有哪裡不同！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 即使是相同的寶可夢，\n強項也會隨著個體而不同。

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 很～好！來一戰吧！\n就當成去工地前的暖身運動！

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳很厲害耶！\n平常都做些什麼運動啊！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 難得的休假，\n我卻捨不得放下清掃用具。\r\n……完全是職業病呢！

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 哦～～呵！呵！呵！\n要怎麼料理才好呢？

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我正準備在野餐中做三明治的，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳來做什麼啊！

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 寶可夢受傷了，\n就餵牠吃三明治來讓牠回復吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 輸給我的話，\n您的金額就會是１００萬喔～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 剛才是開玩笑的啦！\n獎金還是要維持在行情價……對吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 飛翔計程車的動力來源\n是怒鸚哥的努力！

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 聽說野生的怒鸚哥\n會依照顏色來各自群聚呢！

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我的地圖App轉個不停～！\n快點幫幫我～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
原來地圖App可以把北方
固定在畫面的上方啊。\c
上年紀之後，
連看個手機也好折騰喲！

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是不是在學校裡\n跟克拉韋爾校長聊得很親密！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 說到克拉韋爾校長，\n他的身段柔軟，很讓人喜歡呢……

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 服務生，waiter，就是要等待。\n我會在等待之後進行應對。

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 有時候刻意選擇後攻\n也是一種戰術。\r\n雖然等待得太久也可能導致敗北。

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 向日花怪快快開花！\n向日花怪快快開花！\r\n這是我自己想的繞口令喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 向日花怪快怪……\n好痛！咬到舌頭了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
向日花怪快快開花！
我很喜歡向日花怪，所以拿牠做了繞口令。\c
對我來說，深缽道館的道館測驗
簡直是太棒了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 工作是我活著的動力！\n勞動讓我感到有價值！

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 既然輸了，就回去工作吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 把自己喜歡的事情變成工作，\n大半的人生就會快樂起來喔！\r\n不過，也會有辛苦的時候就是了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 這一帶有天星隊火幫班的基地喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 火幫班裡那個叫做梅洛可的老大，\n她嘴巴很壞，可怕得不得了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 帕底亞巨坑……\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳去過嗎？

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 據說帕底亞巨坑裡有個\n叫做第零區的地方，\r\n很多金銀財寶在那裡沉睡著喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我要變成最強！\n以首席為目標！

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我跟[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳會成為雙首席！

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 在冠軍裡面還有著\n最強的冠軍──\r\n首席冠軍！我好崇拜喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 人家啊～\n想變得跟妮莫\r\n一樣厲害～

entries.label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
嗚……嗚嗚……
謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳跟我對戰……\c
如果是妮莫的話，
是不是輸了也不會難過啊？

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳就是我的交易對象嗎？\n說好的東西帶來了沒？

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我認錯人了！？\n請、請放過我吧！！

entries.label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 別妨礙我！\n我有個看別人展示可愛的寶可夢\r\n這項重要交易！

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: 那隻寶可夢好像很好吃……　▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 該怎麼說呢……就是啊……\n我看到了好像很好吃的寶可夢。

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 該怎麼說呢……\n謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳跟我對戰。

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
好像很好吃的寶可夢走著走著，
就被好大的寶可夢一口吃掉了。\c
像那樣昭告天下自己很好吃，
當然會被吃掉啊……

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我聽聞這個地方有著叫做\n「偽龍寶主」的寶可夢，所以就來了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 「偽龍」是什麼玩意！？\n我才是真正的龍……！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 所謂的偽龍寶主，\n該不會是假的龍吧？\r\n不是龍的話就沒意義呢～

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 待會兒我打贏[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳之後，\n請幫我拍下照片～

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 打輸的照片就不用拍了～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 抱歉啊。來到大自然裡，\n整個人就不禁得意起來了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 吸～～吐～～！\n吸～～吐～～！\r\n嗯～～多麼美味的空氣！

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 這裡的空氣棒極了。\n配個３碗飯不是問題。

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 在草叢中蹲太久，腰都痛了……

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 要是我的腰好好的，\n我可能就贏了？

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 蹲在草叢裡就能在不被注意到的\n情況下靠近寶可夢。\r\n……但小心別傷到腰喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳嬌小的個子能來到這種地方，\n真不簡單呢～

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 個子嬌小，實力卻很強大！

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
這一帶既沒有城鎮，
也沒有寶可夢中心。\c
要是累了就不要勉強，
直接呼叫飛翔計程車喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我啊～是個歌手，\n來這裡勘查ＭＶ的取景地。

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我不要在這裡拍攝了！\n免得回想起自己曾經輸給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳！

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 為了尋找帕底亞地區最美麗的景色，\n我正在四處旅行。

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的雙眼所看到的是什麼呢？

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 雖然我覺得最美的景色\n就在這裡了……\r\n但應該還有更加壯麗的地方吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 啊！失禮了。\n我一時亂了方寸。

entries.label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我和蘑菇寶可夢玩著玩著，\n看牠實在太可愛，便不小心失了方寸。

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 攀崖讓我……喘不過氣……\n寶可夢倒是……很有精神……

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 要是能騎在寶可夢身上……\n攀崖的話……該有多好啊……

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 借我能渡海的坐騎寶可夢！

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 有能渡海的\n坐騎寶可夢的話，\r\n就能去島上度假了說～

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 東邊有天星隊的基地，\n好可怕喔～

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 跟[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一樣強的話，\n就天不怕地不怕了吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 天星隊格鬥幫班\n在東邊設有基地，\r\n他們的老大超可怕……長相的部分。

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳從學校出發之後，\n千里迢迢地來到這裡啊。

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我感受到了[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳累積起來的經驗。

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
我們明明走了相同的距離，
我卻輸給了[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳。\c
可見[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳到此為止的路途
比我還要充實啊。

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 這不是真的吧～！我之前還在霜抹山上\n滑雪的啊。這是什麼地方～！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 雖然是偶然間闖進來的地方～\n但也滿快樂的～好吧，算了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 欸欸，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳啊！我可是為了找[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳而\n上窮碧落下黃泉喔！\r\n……這句話是什麼意思啊！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 其實只要搜尋一下，\n馬上就能知道答案。\r\n不過，跟別人一起傷腦筋也很有趣呢。

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 三明治這種東西啊，聽說是一位\n喜歡遊戲的伯爵想要一邊用餐\r\n一邊玩遊戲而發明出來的喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 寶可夢對戰就沒辦法\n跟其他事情一起做了～

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我對事物的歷史很有興趣，\n歷史考試也都拿滿分。

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我是掌管龍之翅膀的大姐！\n被拍打的翅膀揮得遠遠的吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 龍的成長速度很緩慢，不過長大之後\n能用很驚人的力量振翅高飛。

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我是掌管龍之氣息的二姐！\n被吐出的氣吹得遠遠的吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 龍很怕冰屬性的招式……\n對可愛的妖精也沒轍……

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我是掌管龍之尾巴的小妹！\n被尾巴咻～地甩得遠遠的吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 三姐妹各掌管龍身上的一個部位這個設定\n是姐姐想出來的……\r\n我自己是覺得有點害羞啦。

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_OL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 辦公室女郎到了戶外\n也會變成狂野女郎！！

entries.label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_OL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 辦公室女郎叫做ＯＬ，\n那狂野女郎是不是就叫……ＷＬ？

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
entries.text: 一顆竹筍冒出來，\n兩顆竹筍冒出來～　▶

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我是來採竹筍的。\n順便跟幾個訓練家過招吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 在對戰的途中，\n我也一直想著竹筍……

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 大竹筍非常珍貴，\n所以能在店裡高價賣出。

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 哎呀～我的天哪！\n本來以為是蘑菇，結果牠是活的！

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 蘑菇寶可夢哎呀球菇\n可是有毒的，要多注意啊。

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 這片瀑布好像很有名喔。\n我就和[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳對戰一場當作留念吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 得意忘形過頭，\n汗都流成了瀑布！

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 亂擊瀑布這個名字啊……\n改成超級水流噴射大瀑布\r\n之類的不是比較帥氣嗎？

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 「職業摔角」是嗎？\n那在年輕人之間很流行嗎？

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的對戰能力有職業水準。

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
我剛剛在前面看到一位
穿得像是職業摔角手的學生。\c
那模樣真的很帥氣，
就請那個人讓我成為同伴吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我透過空手道函授教學\n成為了空手道王！

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 現在已經是連學習都能\n透過遠距實現的時代了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 人家啊，很、厲、害、喔！\n就讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳，見、識、見、識！

entries.label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳啊，很、厲、害、呢！\n人家啊，很、欣、賞、喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 背包客很怕遇到\n鋼屬性的招式喔！

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我很怕遇到現實屬性喔！\n因為我不想面對現實！哈哈……

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 贏過我的話，\n我就告訴[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳學校的秘密！

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我輸了啊～\n那只好把秘密告訴[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳囉～

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
我入學的時候，
學校發生了很糟糕的問題喔！\c
那個問題使得所有老師都離開，
然後現在這些新老師才進來的！

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我受夠做什麼鬼研究了！\n讓我把工作忘得一乾二淨吧！！

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是怎麼培育寶可夢的？餵牠吃什麼？\n招式是用招式學習器學會的？這樣啊……

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我就算想忘掉研究也忘不了……\n所以才會是個研究員。

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我，很強。\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳，更強。\r\n如此罷了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我其實是……\n扮裝成快遞員啦～

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 快遞員的扮裝！\n這其實小有人氣喔。

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳出現在這裡\n不是因為遇難嗎！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我原本正在追寶可夢，\n追著追著就小小地遇難了！\r\n叫飛翔計程車來接我吧！

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 這裡是我的地盤！\n要搭帳篷的話閃一邊去！

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳不是來露營，而是來健行的？

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 在山裡吃的飯特別香呢！\n疲勞真是最棒的調味料。

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 不覺得單板滑雪的退役選手\n古魯夏遭遇的事故很叫人遺憾嗎？

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳那個世代不知道的話題嗎？\n抱歉抱歉！

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 古魯夏曾經是世界排名第２的\n單板滑雪選手……\r\n但他在事故中受傷後就退役了。

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 在這片酷寒之地！\n我明白了一件事！

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 就算是在寒冷的地方修行，\n也會引發感冒而使效率降低！\r\n哈哈……哈～啾！

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 那身制服跟[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳真是搭啊！\n不知跟叔叔我是不是也很搭？

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 穿著制服精神滿滿地冒險！\n叔叔不由得回想起自己的學生時代。

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 今天的受試者就決定是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳了！\n讓我收集[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的數據～！

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 沒有收集到數據！\n是機械故障了嗎……？

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我在岩地扭到腳了。\n請讓我用對戰來忘掉疼痛。

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 雖然忘掉了腳上的痛，\n但輸掉對戰讓我心碎了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 寶可夢攜帶著樹果的話，\n就能在受到小傷時回復體力\r\n或治癒異常狀態，真是方便。

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我收集到了３個道館徽章，\n但面試測驗還是沒及格！！

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: ３個道館徽章的程度\n連小孩子都不如！？

entries.label: TRID_AREA19_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 沒收集到８個徽章的話，\n寶可夢聯盟在面試測驗時\r\n就不會把我當回事嗎……？

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 這是個美麗的地方，\n但那跟紙糊一樣的基地有夠礙眼！

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我一不小心就亂發脾氣了。\n抱歉抱歉。

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 原來那個基地是天星隊\n那群傢伙的據點啊？\r\n他們到底花了多少力氣建起來的？

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我是為了加入天星隊而來的！

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 連一般學生都贏不了的話，\n根本當不了隊員吧……

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我的實力還不足以加入天星隊。\n我會再來的。唉唉……

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我想用音樂的力量\n讓所有人幸福！

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要跪倒在音樂的力量\n之下才對啊～！！

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 與其培養音樂的力量，\n我還是先培養對戰的實力吧……

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_OL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 在這一帶的寶可夢中心上班，\n會不會很輕鬆呢？

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_OL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 呃啊啊～！\n得去讓寶可夢回復了！

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_OL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 就是因為有[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳這樣的孩子，\n寶可夢中心八成也忙得團團轉。

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我和男朋友來這裡野餐……\n現在正好閒著，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳就來當我的對手吧。

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 都已經幾歲了，還在野餐約會。\n又不是小孩子……[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳說對吧？

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我和女朋友來這裡野餐！\n幫忙讓我胸口的悸動鎮靜下來！！

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 我現在還是好激動。\n怦咚，怦咚，怦咚……

entries.label: TRID_AREA20_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我要和女朋友一起做三明治，\n悠閒地度過時光！

entries.label: TRID_AREA24_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的學校裡有沒有一位叫做\n米莫莎的老師？她是我以前的同事。

entries.label: TRID_AREA24_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text:
我和米莫莎曾經一起在
寶可夢中心上班過。\c
現在雖然各自走上了不同的道路，
不過她也成為了盡職的老師呢……

entries.label: TRID_AREA25_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我為了捕捉海裡的寶可夢，\n特地游泳來到這裡。

entries.label: TRID_AREA25_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 如果有什麼稀奇的寶可夢，\n就算要到天涯海角我也照游不誤。

entries.label: TRID_AREA26_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 找不到……\n找不到……\r\n我在尋找自己的可能性。

entries.label: TRID_AREA26_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 小孩子充滿了可能性，\n對大叔我來說太過耀眼了。

entries.label: TRID_SISTER_01_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳為什麼沒被我的\n輕便和服打扮給迷住！

entries.label: TRID_SISTER_01_02_STRONG_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳為什麼沒被我的\n輕便和服打扮給迷住！

entries.label: TRID_SISTER_01_03_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 真是的！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳這傢伙也太強了！

entries.label: TRID_SISTER_01_03_STRONG_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
entries.text: 真是的！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳這傢伙也太強了！

entries.label: TRID_SP_TRAINER_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我乃鬼面組正宗！\n被我奇異的招式玩弄吧！！

entries.label: TRID_SP_TRAINER_01_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我已竭盡全力！\n毫無……悔恨！

entries.label: TRID_SP_TRAINER_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我乃鬼面組長谷部！\n控雨自如，穿敵有術！

entries.label: TRID_SP_TRAINER_02_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我已竭盡全力！\n毫無……悔恨！

entries.label: TRID_SP_TRAINER_03_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我乃鬼面組雷切！\n掌雷轟頂，震耳欲聾！！

entries.label: TRID_SP_TRAINER_03_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我已竭盡全力！\n毫無……悔恨！

entries.label: TRID_SP_TRAINER_04_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我乃鬼面組國綱！\n親身體會冰岩之剛硬吧！！

entries.label: TRID_SP_TRAINER_04_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我已竭盡全力！\n毫無……悔恨！

entries.label: TRID_SP_TRAINER_05_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我乃鬼面組兼光！\n與我作對，就是與老天爺為敵！！

entries.label: TRID_SP_TRAINER_05_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我已竭盡全力！\n毫無……悔恨！

entries.label: TRID_SP_TRAINER_06_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我乃鬼面組宗近！\n懾服在我純粹的力量下吧！！

entries.label: TRID_SP_TRAINER_06_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
entries.text: 我已竭盡全力！\n毫無……悔恨！

entries.label: TRID_SP_TRAINER_07_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
entries.text: 我乃鬼面組虎徹！\n精進武藝，擊潰來敵！！

entries.label: TRID_SP_TRAINER_07_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
